_source: 01_Customer_Import 1.xlsx (Subrato, 06-Aug-2026). Every yellow column across the 15 sheets is a newly-mapped/changed rule; its row-4 note is the instruction. Most were already implemented on 03-Aug; this file carries the CHANGES and the genuinely new columns, dated 06-Aug so they beat the 03-Aug statements they revise.
_scope: Client NextPower, source NetSuite, target object Customer. Each rule is scoped to the sheet the workbook flagged it on. Applies at generate time to every conversion, so it covers both the FBDI and CSV outputs (one transform pipeline feeds both).
_precedence: Dated with a TIME (06-Aug 23:59), not just a day. The store resolves precedence on the full timestamp — latest wins — and the tool auto-captures its own generated output as timestamped learnings, so a plain 06-Aug (midnight) document lost to a same-day capture made at 15:59/20:52 and kept the old value. Stamping the document late on its own day makes it the latest 06-Aug statement, so it wins over those same-day captures while staying correctly dated 06-Aug. It still loses to a genuine HUMAN edit made later, which is what should happen (latest wins), and human edits are additionally protected by approver.

rules.note: 01_Customer_Import (06-Aug), Parties C4: 'Source column: internalid (from customer.csv) - currently shows values from entityid, instead of internalid'. Mapped to internalid ONLY on the Parties sheet, where the customer's own internalid is directly present (analyst choice: 'only where it maps directly'). The child sheets keep the generated reference, so cross-sheet linkage is left exactly as it is.
01_Customer_Import (06-Aug), HZ_IMP_PARTYSITES_T O4: 'should be unmapped'. Recorded as a keep-blank so the control-default pass cannot refill it.

01_Customer_Import (06-Aug), HZ_IMP_PARTYSITEUSES_T I4: 'should be mapped to startdate source column, fallback to datecreated source column if startdate is blank for any row'. COALESCE takes the first non-blank.

01_Customer_Import (06-Aug), HZ_IMP_PARTYSITES_T AV4: 'entityid_internalid_RS (both entityid and internalid source fields to be taken from contacts input sheet)'. CONCAT entityid + _ + internalid, then append _RS. require_all: half a composite key is a wrong key, so a row missing either half blanks rather than shipping a dangling reference.
